summaries.en: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure project designed to help AI systems manage context and stay accountable by organizing information as interconnected graphs rather than isolated data. Its core insight is context engineering: explicitly modeling relationships between entities, decisions, and provenance gives agents traceable memory and makes reasoning steps explainable. You can use it to build persistent agent memory layers, audit AI decisions, or add context management to existing generative AI pipelines, improving reliability and transparency in real-world applications. It provides a Python-based foundation for context-rich, responsible AI development.

summaries.en: This GitHub project compiles a broad collection of free Chinese-language programming books and learning resources, spanning languages like Python and JavaScript as well as platforms such as Android and React. It solves the problem of scattered, expensive study materials by curating them into an organized, community-maintained index. The core strength is its crowdsourced model—anyone can suggest new additions or corrections through pull requests, keeping the list fresh and comprehensive. Learners can quickly find reliable references for self-study, while contributors help expand the collection. This is a practical starting point for Chinese-speaking developers seeking accessible technical education.
